dataset.title: Secondary data analysis project data from RISE study, iWATCH study, and NHANES cohorts
dataset.description: This secondary data analysis project will analyze deidentified data from 48,218 participants from eight studies and the publicly available NHANES cohorts (wrist NHANES 2011-2014; hip/counts-NHANES 2003-2006). The studies include (i) the RISE Study, (ii) the SOL-VIDA Study, (iii) the iWATCH Study, (iv) the MOCA Study, (v) the PHASE Study, (vi) the AusDiab Study, (vii) the ACT Study, and (viii) the WHISH accelerometer sub-study. Sufficient data from those datasets will be preserved to enable sharing to validate and replicate research findings described in the Aims with those datasets only. The final dataset of data from the RISE study, the iWATCH study, and NHANES cohorts will be de-identified. It will be deposited into the UC San Diego Library Data repository along with study protocols, code, and models for public use. De-identified data will be available after the main outcome papers are published.

distribution.title: De-identified data from RISE study, iWATCH study, and NHANES cohorts
distribution.description: De-identified data will be uploaded to the University of California San Diego Library repository. The research community will have access to data when the main outcome manuscript has been published. We anticipate data being available for the foreseeable future (minimum of at least 5 years) after the study has been completed. The University of California San Diego Library repository does not currently have a limit on how long data can be stored.

project.title: Secondary data analysis project
project.description: This secondary data analysis project will analyze deidentified data from 48,218 participants from eight studies and the publicly available NHANES cohorts (wrist NHANES 2011-2014; hip/counts-NHANES 2003-2006). The studies include (i) the RISE Study, (ii) the SOL-VIDA Study, (iii) the iWATCH Study, (iv) the MOCA Study, (v) the PHASE Study, (vi) the AusDiab Study, (vii) the ACT Study, and (viii) the WHISH accelerometer sub-study. The data will be analyzed with custom code by our statistical and computer science team. ActiGraph data will be processed and analyzed using ActiLife software which requires a paid license.
